_comment: Optional price book. You normally do not edit this: when a model has no usable entry here, runs look its price up in a public catalog automatically (see README, 'Time, tokens and cost'). Run `python -B evaluation/scripts/update_prices.py` to refresh entries from the catalog (old prices are kept in each entry's `history`), or add an entry by hand to pin a price, e.g. a negotiated rate: {"input": 1.5, "output": 9.0, "cached_input": 0.15, "source": "contract", "as_of": "2026-10-04"}. Prices are per 1,000,000 tokens. Every run copies the prices it used into its own metadata, so changing this file never rewrites past runs.
